description: Defines the class TestNetworkQualityEstimator, a test utility subclass of NetworkQualityEstimator, with methods to simulate network conditions, retrieve network metrics, and manage network quality observations for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestNetworkQualityEstimator
classes.description: A test subclass of NetworkQualityEstimator providing methods to simulate network conditions, retrieve metrics, and notify observers for testing network quality estimation.

methods.name: RunOneRequest
methods.description: Runs a single URL request to completion.

methods.name: SimulateNetworkChange
methods.description: Overrides the current network type and id, and notifies the estimator of a network change.

methods.name: GetEchoURL
methods.description: Returns a GURL hosted at the embedded test server.

methods.name: GetRedirectURL
methods.description: Returns a GURL with a redirect to another HTTPS URL.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the effective connection type, possibly overridden.

methods.name: GetRecentEffectiveConnectionTypeUsingMetrics
methods.description: Returns recent effective connection type and associated metrics.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfRTTOrThroughputComputed
methods.description: Notifies observers that RTT or throughput estimates have been computed.

methods.name: NotifyRTTAndThroughputEstimatesObserverIfPresent
methods.description: Notifies a specific observer if present.

methods.name: SetStartTimeNullHttpRtt
methods.description: Sets a forced HTTP RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_recent_http_rtt
methods.description: Sets the recent HTTP RTT value.

methods.name: GetRecentRTT
methods.description: Retrieves the recent RTT for a given observation category.

methods.name: SetStartTimeNullTransportRtt
methods.description: Sets a forced transport RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_recent_transport_rtt
methods.description: Sets the recent transport RTT value.

methods.name: GetTransportRTT
methods.description: Returns the transport RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_start_time_null_downlink_throughput_kbps
methods.description: Sets the downlink throughput estimate.

methods.name: set_recent_downlink_throughput_kbps
methods.description: Sets the recent downlink throughput.

methods.name: GetRecentDownlinkThroughputKbps
methods.description: Retrieves recent downlink throughput.

methods.name: GetRTTEstimateInternal
methods.description: Returns the RTT estimate internally stored.

methods.name: set_rtt_estimate_internal
methods.description: Sets the internal RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_start_time_null_end_to_end_rtt
methods.description: Sets a forced end-to-end RTT estimate.

methods.name: set_start_time_null_end_to_end_rtt_observation_count
methods.description: Sets the observation count for end-to-end RTT.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of net log entries of a specific type.

methods.name: GetNetLogLastStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last string value for a key in net log entries.

methods.name: GetNetLogLastIntegerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last integer value for a key in net log entries.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfRTTOrThroughputEstimatesComputed
methods.description: Notifies observers of network quality estimate change.

methods.name: SetAndNotifyObserversOfEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Updates and notifies observers of effective connection type.

methods.name: SetAndNotifyObserversOfP2PActiveConnectionsCountChange
methods.description: Updates and notifies observers of P2P connection count.

methods.name: SetTransportRTTAtastECTSampleCount
methods.description: Sets the count of RTT samples at ECT.

methods.name: ping_rtt_received_count
methods.description: Returns the count of received ping RTTs.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the network quality estimator parameters.

methods.name: RecordSpdyPingLatency
methods.description: Records the latency of a SPDY ping.
